CheckTitle: Bitbucket Pipelines variables holding credentials are secured
Description: A **secured** Bitbucket Pipelines variable is encrypted at rest, hidden in the UI and masked in build logs. This check reports repository pipeline variables whose names indicate a credential but that are not marked secured.
Risk: An unsecured variable is readable in the repository settings by every user with write access and is printed verbatim into **build logs** by any step that dumps its environment. Build logs are retained and widely readable, so an unsecured deployment credential is effectively published to the whole workspace.

Code.Other:
1. Open the repository in Bitbucket
2. Go to **Repository settings > Pipelines > Repository variables**
3. Delete each credential variable that is not secured
4. Re-add it with **Secured** ticked
5. Rotate the credential, since the previous value may already appear in retained build logs
6. Prefer **deployment**-scoped variables so production secrets are only available to production deployment steps
Code.Terraform:
resource "bitbucket_pipeline_variable" "deploy" {
  workspace  = var.workspace
  repository = bitbucket_repository.example.name
  key        = "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
  value      = var.aws_secret
  secured    = true
}

Recommendation.Text: Mark every credential-bearing pipeline variable as secured, scope production secrets to deployment environments, and rotate any secret that was stored unsecured.
